body.x: JJ Tech will exhibit Oringa withFeeling Pen at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in LasVegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri) .

JJ Tech participating in thisexhibition is an edu-tech company that manufactures and develops new concepteducational toys. It was established in 2017 and has always been committed toresearch and development with the best quality and new ideas. The company’sproduct is a haptic electronic pen with haptic function, and it is a new typeof electronic pen that is fused with educational contents and game contents.

Devices that are used in existingsmart education are based on visual and auditory training. However, JJ Tech 'sproducts are touch-sensitive elements for visual and auditory elements, so theycan be emotionally educated. By giving visual, auditory, and touching to smartmedia education, it can generate interest, fun, and sensitivity.
